sections.title: Young Guns
sections.html:
• Darius Acuff Jr. (SAC, rookie, 19) had a fine night against the Miami Heat, finishing with 32 points and 10 assists.
  • Cooper Flagg (DAL, 19) put together 25 points and 12 assists against the Brooklyn Nets, a well-rounded evening's work.
  • Jeremiah Fears (NOP, 20) scored 25 points against the Los Angeles Clippers, a solid return for his evening on court.
  • Darryn Peterson (UTA, rookie, 19) scored 26 points against the Minnesota Timberwolves, a strong showing for a rookie.
  • Ace Bailey (UTA, 20) added 7 points and 4 steals against the Minnesota Timberwolves, making his mark on the defensive end.
